items.title: UK government and IDF launch Insurance Partnership for Development
items.summary: The UK government and the Insurance Development Forum have agreed to establish an Insurance Partnership for Development, slated for a formal launch in 2027.

items.title: Clear Group acquires Essex construction broker Blackhawk
items.summary: Clear Group has bought Westcliff-on-Sea specialist Blackhawk Insurance Services to expand its construction capabilities amid a quiet UK distribution market.

items.title: LexisNexis warns on flood risk concentrations in southern England and Wales
items.summary: LexisNexis Risk Solutions analysis indicates that over 10% of properties in parts of the south coast and Wales face rising flood risk by 2030.

items.title: Aon appointed to provide professional indemnity insurance for RICS members
items.summary: Aon has been selected by the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors to provide professional indemnity insurance and risk management to UK members.
